scope: Historical Sleepy application calibration and diagnostics. The independent public runtime uses official Kyant AndroidLiquidGlass 2.0.0; these app captures are not equivalence validation of that public backend.
privacy: Only control/synthetic fixture crops and numerical observations exported. No user schedule, photographs, account data, status bars, or raw device video.
reproduction: python3 docs/evidence/render_figures.py reads only committed data/crops. export_sources.py requires the original capture archive to replace inputs.

Original methodological interpretation, including video/trace alignment and moving-release limitations.
Archived eight-rest horizontal body-profile errors; export only the after/rim4 mean and profile statistics. Profiles are not recomputed from raw pixels by the public figure renderer.
Archived neutral/fine-grid edge RGB profile summary, rim3 baseline; inward 0..6 logical units, 8-bit channel values.
Archived neutral/fine-grid edge RGB profile summary, rim4; retain light top degradation and dark residuals.
Secondary fine-grid dark menu threshold diagnostics, not primary shape validation. Export fixed 2..24 depth rows with all threshold crossings present; retain grid/rim/shadow contamination.

Archived edge method: 16 logical units tangential average, interpolated original pixel centers, inward 0..6 RGB-profile RMSE; rim3 to rim4 failure retained.
Archived primary/secondary distinction, frozen fine-grid dark color thresholds 110/130/150, and native grid/rim/shadow dip explaining the retained outlier.
